title: Which Friend Gets My Face
tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person should I swap your face onto—the person on the left or the person on the right? I’ll leave the other face and the rest of the photo unchanged.

faults.what: The swapped face is slightly softer and smoother than the surrounding photograph, subtly reducing facial detail.

judge.summary: The correct woman's face was swapped with a convincing blend, while the man and the rest of the beach photo remain unchanged, with only slight softness in the edited face.

must_haves.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The right woman's facial features are changed toward the source portrait, while her blonde hair remains intact.

must_haves.item: The bearded man's face on the left remains unchanged.
must_haves.why: His features, expression, beard, and lighting match the original beach photo.

must_haves.item: The replaced face is recognizable and blended to match the beach lighting and head angle.
must_haves.why: The source's eyes, brows, and nose are recognizable, and the replacement follows the target head angle with warm beach lighting and no obvious seams.

must_haves.item: The original bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The bodies, clothing straps, hair, ocean, sand, and landscape composition match the original.
No text is visible in the output.
